weakness: SMS-based MFA; reused passwords; passwords (including the Client B gateway password) saved in the browser; no lost-phone procedure; default router admin password
source: P07 assessment (IA-05c., d., e., f., g., h.[01]); P03 G-023 and G-022
remediation_plan: Delete browser-saved passwords; password manager with unique passphrases; authenticator app or security key on the suite; recovery codes in the sealed envelope (POL-01 7.6); lost-phone steps in P08; change the router admin password
milestones: 2026-09-15 browser passwords deleted, password manager and app MFA in use; 2026-09-30 recovery codes sealed; 2026-10-31 router password changed with the business network
resources_required: Password manager about $40 a year; owner time (3 hours)

weakness: Daily work, email, and client relay connections in one administrator account on one laptop
source: P07 assessment (AC-06); P03 G-020 note; P01 R-002
remediation_plan: Standard account for daily work; administrator only for installs; dedicated field laptop used only for client relay and gateway work
milestones: 2026-09-30 standard account in use; 2026-12-31 field laptop set up and checked against Client B's checklist

weakness: Accounting SaaS owner account has no MFA; suite administrator relies on SMS codes
remediation_plan: Turn on app-based MFA on the accounting SaaS and the suite administrator account; tell clients in writing that bank details never change by email alone
milestones: 2026-09-15 MFA on and tested on both

weakness: Open share link on a Client B folder (removed 2026-07-23); drafter share (removed 2026-07-21); no routine share review
source: P07 assessment (AC-03); P03 G-010 and G-007
remediation_plan: Owner-only client folders (done 2026-07-23); external sharing off by default; quarterly share review (POL-01 7.8); signed drafter access agreement
milestones: 2026-07-23 client folders owner-only; 2026-09-30 drafter agreement signed; 2026-10-01 first quarterly review

weakness: USB drives mixed personal and client use; scanned only at Client B
remediation_plan: Two dedicated, labeled drives for settings files, scanned before each site use; personal files moved off; old client files wiped
milestones: 2026-09-30 dedicated drives in use; old drives wiped

weakness: Sign-in history and file activity never reviewed
source: P07 assessment (AU-06a. to c.); P03 G-015
remediation_plan: Monthly review on the first business day with software vendor advisories (POL-01 7.7); weekly for 3 months after any incident; findings logged and clients told under POL-01 10.2

weakness: No internal reporting duty and no written list of whom to notify or when
source: P07 assessment (IR-06a. and b.); P03 G-013, G-024, G-030
remediation_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and notification matrix; printed contact sheet; add an incident reporting duty to the drafter agreement and the IT technician NDA; walkthrough with the IT technician
milestones: 2026-08-31 runbook adopted; 2026-09-30 contact sheet printed and walkthrough held
